protocol.groups: Ten isolated groups of ten in equal200x300 cells. Each receives15 maintained food pellets. Fixed reference bodies, cruise60, 17–8–3 networks with171 parameters; output turn, positive signal effort, positive sharing effort. No trained legacy models reused.
protocol.access: Training restricts plant access to five randomly assigned members per group, independently redrawn each generation and matched across arms. All members sense their own access flag. This deliberately creates a need for redistribution; it is not an unrestricted natural ecology. Tests compare restricted and open access.
protocol.social_physics: Nearest local neighbor proximity, signed bearing, visibility, hunger; strongest attenuated prior-tick signal and bearing; density; own food access. All decisions use a common position/energy/signal snapshot. Signal costs.2*effort per living second. Positive sharing offers at most12*effort energy/s to the nearest living same-group neighbor within48px. Reserve10; efficiency.8; cap recipient room, proportionally scale competing gifts. Post-food pre-transfer snapshots prevent forwarding newly received gifts in the same tick. Sharing includes initial stored reserves as well as food-derived energy.
protocol.selection: Individual: top20 actors by actual age, balanced five children each, mixed among teams. Group: top2 group mean ages, clone each complete ten-member team five times with member permutations. Both select20 parent genomes and make100 offspring; neural mutation.1 probability/.1 Gaussian scale. Common per-child mutation stream, separate assignment RNG. Bodies fixed. Group policy changes incentives AND assortment.
protocol.demography: Finite60s windows; censored survivors remain alive. All newborns, including dead genomes, retained for selection. No within-window reproduction or permanent demographic extinction claim. Selection score is age only; no reward for transfers, signals, or meals.
protocol.tests: Freeze full final evaluated birth banks without an extra reproduction and retain original founders. Six cases per access environment: group, individual, group sharing blocked, founder, founder sharing blocked, group received signals hidden. All six match layout, food, heading, lifespan and access roles; every new scenario excluded from all current training starts. No evolution during testing.
protocol.primary: Six paired mean-age tests: group versus individual, final group sharing benefit, and final sharing benefit minus founder sharing benefit, each in restricted/open tests. Exact two-sided sign tests,1e-10 ties, Holm across all six. Direction requires adjusted p<.05 and paired pointwise95% mean-difference interval excluding zero. Evolved beneficial cooperation requires all three restricted contrasts higher.
protocol.intervals: 20000 paired percentile bootstrap resamples; source seed is independent unit, never members or descendant teams.
protocol.secondary: Horizon survival, dependent survival, food, emitted/received signal measures, actual transfers, and signal-mask intervals are descriptive. Undefined dependent means in open access remain missing. No confirmatory signal p-value.
protocol.limitations: Stylized access restriction and lossy stored-energy transfer. Group selection is bundled with preserved team assortment. No drift training control. More sharing alone is not evidence of cooperation; final benefit must exceed both blocked sharing and founder benefit. Local neighbor hunger is directly observable, so signals may be redundant. Results do not establish reciprocal intent, language, unrestricted ecological cooperation, or a general evolutionary law.
